exec: pm.test('required fields present', () => plans.forEach(p => { ['operatorId','circleId','planCode','amount'].forEach(f => pm.expect(p, f).to.have.property(f)); pm.expect(p.planCode).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(p.amount).to.be.a('number'); }));
pm.test('planCode has no underscore (sku split safe)', () => plans.forEach(p => pm.expect(p.planCode).to.not.include('_')));
const keys = plans.map(p => [p.operatorId, p.circleId, p.planCode, Math.trunc(p.amount)].join('_'));
const dups = keys.filter((k, i) => keys.indexOf(k) !== i);
console.log('op', pm.iterationData.get('op'), 'cir', pm.iterationData.get('cir'), 'plans', plans.length, 'duplicate skus', JSON.stringify(dups));
